SHAAKSTAGE.Title: Stage
SHAAKSTAGE.Lineup: Show the rest of the stage beside the speaker (on/off)
SHAAKSTAGE.SearchHint: Showing player characters. Type to search every actor.
SHAAKSTAGE.EmptyStage: Nobody on stage yet. Drag actors here from the sidebar, or add them below.
SHAAKSTAGE.DropAdd: Drop to add to the stage (hold Shift to add as unknown)
SHAAKSTAGE.DropNotActor: Drag an actor (or a token) from the sidebar onto the Stage panel.
SHAAKSTAGE.DropImport: That actor is in a compendium. Import it into the world first, then drag it from the Actors sidebar.
SHAAKSTAGE.Speak: Click to make this character speak
SHAAKSTAGE.NoPresets: No presets yet. Set up a stage, then save it.
SHAAKSTAGE.PresetMissing: Some actors in that preset no longer exist and were skipped.
SHAAKSTAGE.ActorMissing: Can't find the actor for that stage slot on this browser. Remove it and add the actor again.
SHAAKSTAGE.Clean: Re-clean this character's image (removes the light edge fringe)
SHAAKSTAGE.CleanFailed: Couldn't clean the image for {name}, so the image they already have is being used.
SHAAKSTAGE.SilhouetteFailed: Couldn't build a silhouette for that image, so it was not staged as unknown.

Style.Name: Stage style
Style.Hint: Name plate and backdrop look. Seen by everyone.

AutoClean.Name: Clean images automatically
AutoClean.Hint: Remove the thin light fringe some cut-outs have. The first time an actor is staged, the module makes one cleaned copy of their image and uses it from then on. Turn off to only clean when you press an actor's clean button. Existing cleaned copies are always used.

CleanDir.Name: Cleaned images folder
CleanDir.Hint: Where the cleaned copies are saved, one file per actor (named after the actor's ID). Leave blank for worlds/<this world>/shaak-stage-clean. The folder is created for you.

Enabled.Name: Show stage portraits
Enabled.Hint: Turn off to never render portraits on this client.

Side.Name: Portrait side
Side.Hint: Which side of the screen this client shows the portrait on.

LineupMax.Name: Lineup: max extra characters
LineupMax.Hint: How many other staged characters to show behind the speaker. 0 turns the lineup off on this client (lowest memory use).

Thumbs.Name: Thumbnails in the GM panel
Thumbs.Hint: Turn off to show names only (lowest memory use).

Strip.Name: Quick-swap strip (GM)
Strip.Hint: A slim column of staged characters on screen: click to speak, right-click to hide/reveal.
